title: Site Transfer Terms by Plan for Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
Whether a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement may follow the business to another of its sites, the plan's site transfer fee and the utility requirement are fixed per plan as follows.

| Plan | Agreement may be moved to another site of the same business on relocation | Plan site transfer fee | New site must be served by the same electric utility |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable | no | 0.00 USD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 12 | yes | 50.00 USD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 24 | yes | 50.00 USD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Fixed 36 | yes | 50.00 USD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 24 | yes | 50.00 USD | yes |
| Beacon Ridge Business Green 36 | yes | 50.00 USD | yes |

**Points of reading**

- The transfer permission says whether the agreement may be moved to another site of the same business when it relocates. Every fixed and Green plan permits it; Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable does not.
- The plan site transfer fee is the fee figure the plan sets for moving the agreement to a new site: 50.00 USD on every plan that permits a transfer and 0.00 USD on Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable.
- The utility requirement is "yes" on every plan: the new site must be served by the same electric utility as the old one.

**Hypothetical pairs of sites**

| Old site's utility | New site's utility | Meets the same-utility requirement |
|---|---|---|
| Utility A | Utility A | yes |
| Utility A | Utility B | no |
